name: § 79, after point f – 149
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: (f a) Firmly opposes the renovation works on the Spaak building in Brussels, the cost of which exceeds EUR 500 million; recalls that, pursuant to Article 341 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) and Protocol No 6, the seat of the European Parliament is in Strasbourg;
